governed_construct: One AI interaction: a call in the file that sends a prompt/messages to a language-model provider or consumes a model response stream (e.g. streamText/generateText/generateObject/streamObject/useChat calls, provider-SDK calls such as openai.chat.completions.create or anthropic.messages.stream, or a fetch/HTTP request to a model endpoint).
interpretation: The rule requires that AI interactions go through the Vercel AI SDK: the `ai` package core functions (streamText, generateText, streamObject, generateObject, tool, embed) with @ai-sdk/* provider factories, or the AI SDK UI hooks (useChat, useCompletion from @ai-sdk/react or ai/react). An instance conforms only if the called function is BOUND to an export of `ai`/`@ai-sdk/*` (named, aliased, or namespace import). An instance is non-conforming if the model is reached via a provider SDK directly (openai, @anthropic-ai/sdk, @google/generative-ai, etc.) or via a hand-rolled fetch to a model endpoint, including when that path is wrapped in a local function that happens to be named like an AI SDK function. A file mixing AI SDK calls with any direct provider call is VIOLATED (all-instances semantics). Files with no model interaction at all (e.g. chat-history utilities, type definitions) are NOT_APPLICABLE. Type-only imports from provider packages are not instances.
